reviews.text: I took my dog ​​here for a leg problem, which was quickly resolved. I thank Dr. Alazio and Nurse Rettino for their kindness and professionalism! A well-deserved 5 stars.
Professional and competent vets, very friendly too! I felt completely at ease! And my cat thanks you 😘💪🏾 …

We had an emergency this evening and are truly grateful to have met Dr. Alazio. He was incredibly kind and helpful even over the phone.
Once we arrived at the hospital, he immediately took care of our kitten and quickly resolved the situation, making us feel truly in good hands.

It was reassuring to find such professionalism, but above all, such compassion and attention to our kitten and to us.

We will definitely be back for future visits. Thank you so much! Highly recommended! ❤️🐾

Thank you so much for your review, Tiziano! We're happy you had a positive experience and greatly appreciate your support.

Croce Azzurra Hospital Team
I highly recommend this clinic, both for 24/7 emergencies and as a midweek referral clinic. Excellent staff in Rome.
We went on Sunday, my dog ​​couldn't move his hind legs anymore, they didn't have room for the MRI and hospitalization, we were sent away by the girl at reception!!!!!

The blonde lady at the reception was very rude, unfriendly, had zero empathy, and acted annoyed, as if she were doing me a favor, therefore unprofessional.
The doctors were kind, but they didn't solve the problem, nor did they even try to understand the cause.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at the Croce Azzurra Veterinary Clinic, and especially to Dr. Alazio.
From the first moment, we were greeted with extraordinary empathy, professionalism, and a human warmth that truly makes a difference in times of intense anxiety. Dr. Alazio demonstrated rare sensitivity and expertise in caring for my sweet Fionetta: he examined her with infinite gentleness, explaining every step with clarity, patience, and great transparency.
Knowing that Fionetta is in such safe, attentive, and loving hands gives us great strength. Even though she's not well right now and the road is still uphill, we're crossing our fingers and hoping with all our hearts that she gets better soon.
I wholeheartedly recommend this facility to anyone looking not only for impeccable professionals, but also for people who truly love animals. Thank you so much, Dr. Alazio!

Kiss (Australian Shepherd) arrived at the clinic with a wound and a serious infection on her right hind leg. Dr. Dromi treated her with extreme kindness, care, and professionalism, following her through every stage of recovery. She prescribed an antibiotic ointment that wasn't readily available in pharmacies, and the clinic provided it without any problem. Kiss is now doing well thanks to the doctor's extraordinary expertise. Thank you so much 🙏🏻

Thanks to all the hospital staff, truly good and professional, they saved my Rott's life ❤️ after he was poisoned by a nasty tick they made it impossible to get him up safe and sound thanks again 🙏🏿keep it up 👏🏽 …
